top_news.title: Framing by Wording, Framing by Selection: A Large-Scale Two-Dimensional Audit of French News Headlines, 2022-2025
top_news.dek: Researchers propose a two-dimensional framework to decouple salience framing from selection framing in news headlines.
top_news.brief: Current computational methods often conflate how news is worded with what is selected for coverage. This new framework separates salience (measured via loaded vocabulary, blame, and rhetorical devices) from selection (measured via outlet-level story distributions). The study utilizes a 10,000-headline French dataset annotated by LLMs to provide a more granular audit of media bias.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the two-dimensional axis of news framing: salience versus selection.

top_news.title: AI was supposed to hit new grads hard. So far, unemployment data says otherwise.
top_news.dek: Recent unemployment data shows no evidence of widespread job displacement for new graduates due to AI adoption.
top_news.brief: Despite concerns that AI would significantly reduce entry-level hiring, current labor market data indicates that new graduates are not experiencing a surge in unemployment. Analysts report no widespread displacement in hiring trends across sectors.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing stable unemployment rates for recent college graduates

top_news.title: Anthropic: Claude computes a nine-loop amplitude in N=4 super-Yang-Mills
top_news.dek: Anthropic's Claude model successfully computed a nine-loop amplitude in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory.
top_news.brief: Physicist Matt von Hippel challenged AI models to solve a complex problem in theoretical physics. Claude demonstrated the capability to compute a nine-loop amplitude, a task previously considered difficult for LLMs, highlighting advancements in reasoning for scientific applications.

top_news.title: Meta's Muse appears to use an OpenAI model labeled muse-special
top_news.dek: Technical analysis suggests Meta's Muse may be utilizing an OpenAI-derived model labeled muse-special.
top_news.brief: Independent research into the Muse platform uncovered references to a model labeled 'azure/muse-special'. The findings raise questions about whether Meta is distilling OpenAI models or utilizing third-party infrastructure for its current offerings.
